name: @bongtu/pay-web
description: bongtu pay page — the sender-facing static page for stealth receiving: /p/{label} resolves the recipient's directory record, derives a FRESH one-time destination IN THE VISITOR'S BROWSER (@bongtu/core/stealth — no server secret participates), records the announcement BEFORE displaying, parity-checks the server's destination recompute, and shows address + QR + chain facts. Deliberately minimal: no wallet code, no proving code, no framework — @bongtu/core + a QR encoder is the whole dependency surface, because the visitor holds nothing and signs nothing.
